title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: V7 At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini). The product V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve . Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems. Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini. Build workflows around your processes. Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time. Explore workflows . Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge. The Context Graph connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on. Turn analysis into work your team can use. Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses. Explore document generation . The team you’ll be joining and impact you’ll have A small Platform team with a very wide remit: cloud, SRE, DevOps, developer experience, compliance, and the infrastructure behind our AI products. We run AWS first across multiple regions, with GCP and Azure alongside. Our model providers come through all three, so this is genuinely multi-cloud work. We're in the process of making everything faster, more reliable and nicer to work with, for enterprise customers who expect a lot. There are a number of compliance and big expansion projects on the horizon Our engineers lean heavily on AI coding agents and sandboxes. You’ll shape how that works across the company, giving people freedom while keeping us in control. What you’ll be doing from day one: Owning our infrastructure as code in Terraform, plus alerting, observability (Prometheus, Grafana) and reliability, including load testing and disaster recovery exercises. Making CI/CD faster (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) and taking obstacles out of engineers’ way, from build times to how they run AI agents day to day. Running the platform behind our AI workloads across Bedrock, Vertex AI and Azure, with a close eye on reliability and cost. Getting on calls with enterprise customers and our commercial team to troubleshoot and answer infrastructure and security questions. Alongside that, compliance work and a spot on the on-call rotation. Who you are Strong AWS in production, ideally multi-region. Hands-on with GCP, with Azure a bonus. You understand how model consumption works through each cloud. Deep experience with Terraform, observability and CI/CD, and you write solid Python (Elixir is a bonus, or you’re keen to learn). A clear communicator who’s happy explaining technical things to a customer, not just to other engineers. Independent and comfortable with ambiguity. You find problems without being handed tickets, and you don’t mind when priorities flip from one week to the next. V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help. title: Senior People Partner - Content
description: About 9fin 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets. Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption. We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide. The opportunity Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most. We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders. You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews. Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on: Strategic Trusted advisor to your leaders : You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters. Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be. Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve : You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion. title: Senior Systems Engineer - Autonomy Behavior
description: Description Senior Systems Engineer - Autonomy Behavior The Role As a Senior Autonomy Behavior Systems Engineer, you will help define and validate how an autonomous vehicle behaves in the real world. You will own one or more behavior areas from requirements through simulation evaluation, road-data review, and release recommendation. This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering, software validation, simulation, and safety. You will turn broad product and safety goals into clear behavior definitions, testable requirements, metrics, test plans, and evidence. You will also need to understand what the results mean, where they are weak, and what should happen next. What You'll Do Own end-to-end validation for one or more autonomous driving behaviors, from initial behavior scoping and requirements definition to product launch. Combine simulation, road data, closed-course testing, and expert review to evaluate behavior across large scenario sets, diverse conditions, software versions, and fleet configurations. Define, deploy, and refine metrics, test strategies and acceptance criteria for autonomous behavior for simulation and road. Partner with teams across and outside the autonomy organization to assess, author, and present behavior readiness for release and launch decisions. Required Qualifications Master's degree in systems engineering, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, robotics, or a related field. 5 or more years of professional experience in systems engineering, autonomous vehicles, robotics, simulation, or safety-critical validation. Proven experience evaluating autonomous vehicles in support of a self-driving fleet launch. Strong understanding of systems engineering fundamentals, including system decomposition, use-case definition, requirements authoring, interface definition, verification planning, and traceability. Professional experience designing or executing simulation-based evaluations at scale, not just isolated scenario demonstrations. Strong Python experience for data analysis, test automation, simulation workflows, and engineering tools and exposure to agentic workflows. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of working effectively across teams. Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholders, resolve ambiguity, set expectations, and drive work to completion without waiting for a perfect process. What Will Give You a Competitive Edge Experience with human benchmarking for behavioral or safety evaluation, including attentive human benchmark data, human percentiles, or expert labeling. Experience with counterfactual analysis in simulation, including comparing an autonomous vehicle response with a human or alternate-system response under the same scene conditions. Familiarity with safety cases, safety claims, and the role of validation evidence in supporting them. Experience with hazard analysis, including structured hazard analysis, scenario-based hazard analysis, failure analysis, or similar methods. Understanding of risk quantification, risk acceptance, risk budgets, and mitigation prioritization. Experience translating legal or regulatory expectations into behavioral requirements, metrics, test coverage, or compliance evidence. Experience with large scenario libraries, synthetic test generation, replay-to-simulation workflows, simulation test protocols, or validation scorecards.
